summary: SafeDeal FINAL backend regression pass. Created independent black-box test file /app/backend/tests/test_safedeal_final_regression.py (19 tests, 19/19 PASS in ~132s). Verified all money-math invariants: fee-preview shape/arithmetic (buyer/seller/split), stablecoin-assumed quote (exchangeFeeUsd=0, quotedFundingCoin USDT-/USDC-, nonStableSurchargeUsd>=2), quote consistency (fee-preview == deal.breakdown pre-funding), fund-from-balance fee LOCK (fee_locked=true, costsEstimated=false, custody==buyerPays, wallet debit exact), release with withdrawal_fee_credit (seller keeps in balance -> profile.withdrawal_fee_credit_usd += withdrawalFeeUsd + activity_log entry), withdrawal fee credit consumption (fee_waived>0, credit decreases, wallet debited by amount), refund via dispute-accept (fee_payer=seller, buyer refund = amount - totalCost), split via dispute-accept (pool 50/50 split, custody conservation), auto-withdraw ON pays immediately (address_cooling_hours=0, activity_log payout_seller, source='settlement', net_usd=amount, fee_usd=0, parked_payout_usd=0), wallet==ledger (running_balance == available+held, sum-of-signed matches), CSV statement export, invoice PDF (party 200 application/pdf, non-party 403/404), negatives (fee-preview amount=0 -> 400, fund-balance insufficient -> 400, withdraw below min -> 400, outsider read deal -> 403/404). All payouts SIMULATED as expected (ESCROW_LIVE_SETTLEMENT off).

minor.issue: Accepts amounts below min_withdrawal_usd (returns 200 with min:10 in payload) without an explicit below_min/error flag. Actual /wallet/withdraw enforces min correctly (400). Consider surfacing a below_min:true or warning field on the quote so the UI can preempt the error.

action_items: Optional: enrich POST /api/safedeal/wallet/withdraw/quote response with an explicit below_min flag / error message when amount < min_withdrawal_usd (currently only POST /wallet/withdraw returns 400).
critical_code_review_comments: All money-math invariants (quote==charged, fee-lock at funding, custody conservation, withdrawal-fee credit lifecycle, 24h cooling-off disabled path with immediate simulated settlement) hold across release / refund / split / auto-withdraw flows.

Wallet ledger reconciliation (available+held == last running_balance == sum(signed)) verified for both buyer and seller across all lifecycle scenarios; statement rows correctly expose kind/signed/running_balance/escrow_id.
test_credentials: SafeDeal passwordless preview auth. POST /api/safedeal/auth/send-code {email} -> data.preview_code; POST /api/safedeal/auth/verify-code {email,code} -> data.token used as header x-safedeal-token. Fresh emails: sd-qa-final-<ts>-{seller,buyer,outsider}@example.com so wallets start at 0.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users each run (fresh timestamped emails), one $800 buyer top-up (simulated), and 5+ SafeDeal deals across lifecycle scenarios (release/refund/split/auto-withdraw/negatives). No existing DB rows were modified or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_safedeal_final_regression.py is a full black-box regression covering fee-preview, quote consistency, fund + lock, release + fee credit, withdrawal fee credit consumption, refund (seller pays), split, auto-withdraw immediate payout, wallet-ledger integrity, CSV export, invoice PDF, and negatives. Runs ~2m 12s. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env with hardcoded preview fallback (no /app/frontend/.env exists in this workspace). Action names discovered: fund-balance / accept / deliver / release / dispute (proposed_outcome: refund|split|cancellation, split_percent_seller) / dispute-accept / cancel. Notable behavior: withdraw quote endpoint does NOT flag below-min (only actual /withdraw 400s); refund with fee_payer=seller returns buyer amount-totalCost (fees stay with platform, matching existing math_audit invariant).
